GREENPEACE ACTIVISTS NABBED OUTSIDE OF ASEAN SUMMIT VENUE 

Read updates here: https://t.co/sUsGXzGoRA

JUST IN: Greenpeace Southeast Asia said several of its activists were brought to a police station in Lapu-Lapu City after staging a peaceful protest during the opening day of the 48th Asean Summit.
 
The group said the activists were calling on Asean leaders to address plastic pollution and fossil fuel dependence. As of posting time, Greenpeace said the activists remained at Lapu-Lapu Police Station 2. | via Pia Piquero #CDNDigital #ASEANSummit2026 #CebuASEAN2026
